text: Polymarket is operated by Blockratize, Inc., a Delaware private company founded by Shayne Coplan; it is venture-backed with Intercontinental Exchange (NYSE: ICE) as a strategic minority investor. Ultimate control remains with the founder and venture investors, with no state stake. Offshore operations run through Adventure One Ltd in Panama.
